<mxfile host="Electron" agent="parameter-golf" version="21.0.0"> <diagram id="arch-vit-peft" name="Architecture"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="560" background="#ffffff" math="1" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<!-- Input Section --> <mxCell id="img_in" value="<b>Input Image</b><br>256 Visual Tokens<br>(max_pixels: 200,704)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="80" width="160" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="txt_in" value="<b>Text Prompt</b><br>"Question: ... Answer:"<br>(Standard Clean Prompt)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="320" width="160" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Vision Backbone Group --> <mxCell id="vit_group" value="<b>Vision Transformer Backbone (ViT 24 Blocks)</b>" style="swimlane;startSize=26;rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;dashed=1;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="40" width="260" height="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vit_frozen" value="Blocks 0 - 20<br><b>[FROZEN]</b><br>Low-level geometry &amp; edges" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eeeeee;strokeColor=#b3b3b3;strokeWidth=1;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="vit_group"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="40" width="200" height="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vit_lora" value="Blocks 21 - 23 (Top 3)<br><b>[ViT-LoRA Injected]</b><br>High-level OCR abstraction<br>(r=16, alpha=32, scale=2.0)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="vit_group"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="105" width="200" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Merger Anchor --> <mxCell id="merger" value="<b>Cross-Modal Merger</b><br><b>[FROZEN ANCHOR]</b><br>Preserves coordinate alignment<br>Prevents feature drift" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="560" y="105" width="180" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- LLM Backbone Group --> <mxCell id="llm_group" value="<b>Qwen3 Language Backbone (28 Decoder Layers)</b>" style="swimlane;startSize=26;rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;dashed=1;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="560" y="240" width="260" height="260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llm_attn" value="Self-Attention Projections<br>(<b>q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj</b>)<br><b>[All-Linear LoRA+]</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="llm_group"> <mxGeometry x="25" y="40" width="210" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llm_ffn" value="MLP SwiGLU Projections<br>(<b>gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj</b>)<br><b>[All-Linear LoRA+]</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="llm_group"> <mxGeometry x="25" y="115" width="210" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llm_loraplus" value="<b>LoRA+ Dynamic Decoupling</b><br>eta_B = 4.0 * eta_A (lambda=4)<br>eta_A = 5e-5, eta_B = 2e-4" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="llm_group"> <mxGeometry x="25" y="190" width="210" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Fusion & Evaluation --> <mxCell id="fusion_box" value="<b>Model Soup &amp; EMA Fusion</b><br>W_soup = 0.5 * W_final + 0.5 * W_ema<br>Zero training cost, 0% latency overhead<br><b>Score: 73.790% (±0.00587)</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#2ca02c;strokeWidth=3;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="870" y="170" width="200" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="eval_out" value="<b>lmms-eval textvqa_val</b><br>5,000 Questions<br>Latency Ratio: 1.020x &lt;= 1.1x<br>VRAM: 8.20GB &lt; 11GB<br>Weight: 69.3MB &lt; 100MB" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="870" y="320" width="200" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges --> <mxCell id="e1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#333333;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="img_in" target="vit_group"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#333333;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="vit_group" target="merger"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#333333;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="merger" target="llm_group"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#333333;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="txt_in" target="llm_group"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#2ca02c;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="llm_group" target="fusion_box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#333333;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="fusion_box" target="eval_out"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
